g.aria-label: h'_j = ξ_j h_j / (1 − p) with ξ_j ~ Bernoulli(1 − p) ⇒ E[h'_j] = h_j
Disable mask at eval (h'_j = h_j): zero test FLOP or memory overhead
Var[h'_j] = (p / (1 − p)) h_j² (std = |h_j| at p = 0.5; 2|h_j| at p = 0.8)
On 40%-corrupted Fashion-MNIST (n=1,000), p=0.5 boosts val acc by +3 to +5 pts
Always toggle net.train() / net.eval() so validation is deterministic
